summary: Frontend-only smoke test for legal screen red-screen fix verified. All 3 legal documents (CGU, Privacy, Mentions Légales) now load successfully without the previous ReferenceError: useMemo is not defined. Each screen renders the legal-screen testID, the legal-back arrow, the correct header title, and the long-form body text in the ScrollView. Bug fix at /app/frontend/app/legal.tsx:1 (added `import { useMemo } from 'react';`) confirmed working.
critical_code_review_comments: legal.tsx has a stale module-level fallback block (lines 200-204) declaring an unused `colors`/`styles` constant — harmless dead code; consider removing in a future cleanup.
Legal docs still contain placeholder values like '[Nom de la société — à compléter]' and '[Numéro SIRET — à compléter]'. These must be filled in before App Store submission.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Direct-route testing approach used: navigate to /legal?doc=cgu | /legal?doc=privacy | /legal?doc=legal. The route is publicly reachable (no auth gate required to render). Mobile viewport 390x844. testIDs: legal-screen, legal-back. Note: Cloudflare returned transient 502s on first attempts in this preview environment — retry-on-502 loop (3 tries with 2.5s delay) is recommended in scripts.
rca_of_issue: Bulk theme-aware refactor introduced `const styles = useMemo(() => makeStyles(colors), [colors])` inside LegalDoc, but legal.tsx was the only file with no prior React hook import, so useMemo was undefined at runtime → ReferenceError → red screen on tap of any 'À propos' row in Settings. Fix: added `import { useMemo } from 'react';` as line 1 of legal.tsx. Verified by direct URL navigation to all 3 doc variants — all render correctly with full content, header title, and back button (testIDs legal-screen and legal-back both present, full French legal text rendered).
